messages:
lin: noticing p99 spikes in apac-edge rack-12 since 01:45 UTC. KV hits dropped 90% -> 50% and egress doubled. suspect long-generated sessions.
kevin: tenant 7832 shows many >80k token streams. any evict alerts?
lin: we got soft-evicts but they bounced. other tenants saw timeouts.
anya: can we do an ephemeral fence for that rack instead of cold eviction? cheaper and faster.
kevin: propose rule: if kv_miss>0.2 && egress>40MB/s for 5m -> create ephemeral-fence (2x A10), attach sessions. auto-scale down on idle 10m.
ops-bot: action started: create-ephemeral-fence rack-12-host2,host4 flavor=a10x2 ttl=20m job=4729
lin: migration in progress, monitoring kv hit and p99.
oncall: note runbook update: when fence active, route new long-streams to quantized fallback and tag @sre.
kevin: quick cost calc: ~ $1.7k/day if left warm; with autoscale it's tiny. we'll add cost alarm.
anya: follow-ups: prototype affinity_by_seq rule and auto-throttle for long streams on PLG tier.
lin: fence looks good, kv-hit to 85% and p99 back. leaving open for 30m for observation.
